annotation.title_clean: Estimating investments in General Purpose Technologies: The case of AI Investments in Europe
annotation.title_en: Estimating investments in General Purpose Technologies: The case of AI Investments in Europe
annotation.venue: AI Watch, JRC Technical Report EUR 30072 EN (Publications Office of the European Union)
annotation.summary_en: JRC AI Watch technical report estimating AI investments in the EU28 in 2018 using patent-based AI intensity coefficients applied to investment data, with country profiles. It finds EU AI investment of roughly €7.0–8.4 billion, about 35–42% of the Coordinated Action Plan's annual target. No robotics or governance provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU28 AI investments in 2018 estimated at €7.0–8.4 billion depending on scenario
This equals 35–42% of the annual investment target in the Coordinated Action Plan
Method applies AI shares from patents, ICT specialists and university programmes to investment categories
Min and max scenarios use patent coefficients for 2000–2016 and 2010–2016
Includes country profiles for EU Member States, including Poland
